question: In which of the following years did Antoine Lavoisier discover the law of conservation of mass and state that mass is conserved in a chemical reaction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1789**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1789** is the year when Antoine Lavoisier discovered the law of conservation of mass.
 
• The law states that mass is conserved in a chemical reaction, meaning the mass of the reactants equals the mass of the products.
